picks.title: Meta's regret over its scrapped AI tool is like a burglar apologising for the mess
picks.excerpt: A pointed critique of Meta walking back a scrapped AI creative tool, questioning whether the reversal reflects genuine concern for creators or damage control — a signal of how platform AI decisions ripple into design and creative work.
picks.rationale: The only clean, never-before-published design candidate this window: a reputable-outlet read on how platform-AI reversals shape the tools creators can trust.
